sql.schedule.getEvents: with start_time as ( select ppscfv.id, ppscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id, ppscfv.project_process_step_id, ppscfv.timestamp_value from flow.project_process_step_custom_field_value ppscfv inner join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on cfga.id = ppscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id where cfga.schedule_field_type_id = 1 ), end_time as ( select ppscfv.id, ppscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id, ppscfv.project_process_step_id, ppscfv.timestamp_value from flow.project_process_step_custom_field_value ppscfv inner join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on cfga.id = ppscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id where cfga.schedule_field_type_id = 2 ), resource as ( select ppscfv.id, ppscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id, ppscfv.project_process_step_id, ppscfv.int_value from flow.project_process_step_custom_field_value ppscfv inner join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on cfga.id = ppscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id where cfga.schedule_field_type_id = 3 ) select cfg.group_name, pps.process_step_id, pps.project_id, pps.id as project_process_step_id, sl.system_list_type_id, st.timestamp_value as start, et.timestamp_value as end, r.int_value as resource_id, c.first_name as customer_first_name, c.last_name as customer_last_name, c.latitude, c.longitude, case when sl.system_list_type_id = 1 then o.org_name else u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name end as resource_name, p.project_name, ps.process_step_name, c.state_id, s.state, pps.process_step_status_type_id, psst.process_step_status_type from flow.custom_field_group cfg inner join flow.project_process_step pps on pps.process_step_id = cfg.process_step_id inner join flow.project p on p.id = pps.project_id inner join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = pps.process_step_id inner join flow.process_step_status_type psst on psst.id = pps.process_step_status_type_id inner join flow.customer c on c.id = p.customer_id inner join flow.state s on s.id = c.state_id left join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga1 on cfga1.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id and cfga1.schedule_field_type_id = 1 left join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga2 on cfga2.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id and cfga2.schedule_field_type_id = 2 left join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga3 on cfga3.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id and cfga3.schedule_field_type_id = 3 left join start_time st on st.project_process_step_id = pps.id and st.custom_field_group_assignment_id = cfga1.id left join end_time et on et.project_process_step_id = pps.id and et.custom_field_group_assignment_id = cfga2.id left join resource r on r.project_process_step_id = pps.id and r.custom_field_group_assignment_id = cfga3.id left join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga3.custom_field_id left join flow.user u on u.id = r.int_value left join flow.org o on o.id = r.int_value left join flow.company_system_list csl on csl.id = cf.company_system_list_id left join flow.system_list sl on sl.id = csl.system_list_id where cfg.schedulable is true and cf.company_id = :companyId and cfg.archived is not true and st.timestamp_value is not null and et.timestamp_value is not null and r.int_value is not null and case when :startTime::date is not null then st.timestamp_value >= :startTime::date else 1=1 end and case when :endTime::date is not null then et.timestamp_value <= :endTime::date else 1=1 end and ( case when array_length(ARRAY[ :orgIds ]::INTEGER[], 1) > 0 then ARRAY[o.id] <@ ARRAY[ :orgIds ]::INTEGER[] end OR case when array_length(ARRAY [ :userIds ]::BIGINT[], 1) > 0 then ARRAY [u.id] <@ ARRAY [ :userIds ]::BIGINT[] end )

pps.process_step_status_type_id, psst.process_step_status_type from flow.project_process_step pps inner join flow.project p on p.id = pps.project_id inner join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = pps.process_step_status_type_id inner join flow.custom_field_group cfg on cfg.process_step_id = ps.id and cfg.schedulable is true left join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga1 on :companyId and ps.archived is not true and c.state_id = :stateId and case when st.timestamp_value is not null then st.timestamp_value >= :startTime::date else 1=1 end and case when st.timestamp_value is not null then st.timestamp_value <= :endTime::date else 1=1 end and case when array_length(ARRAY[ :stepIds ]::INTEGER[], 1) = 0 OR ARRAY[ :stepIds ]::integer[] is null then 1=1 else ARRAY[pps.process_step_id] <@ ARRAY[ :stepIds ]::INTEGER[] end
